result: Cause of the 951/952 release-step exits NOT established (not reproduced in 13 release runs; (a)(b)(c) excluded or not reproduced); exit 99/127 mapped to LOCALE-PER-DIR-LOAD's namespace script; branch makes the failure print its stderr and removes a latent per-call directory race; empty-main instruction deltas measured

gate.affected: see JOBS release-step-exec-fail-gate (direct tier + release pair)

rulings.item: LOCALE-PER-DIR-LOAD's faults_env namespace path is the only code that exits 99/127 in the failing tests; cause still unknown
rulings.recommendation: land this branch first; LOCALE-PER-DIR-LOAD merges next keeping call_dir and run_failure, so its next red names the failing step (mount or exec) with stderr
LD-START-MAPS adds +2422 of the 2972 headroom on next; it should pay for its instructions or carry a ruling; do not loosen the bound

informational: The CI release step runs cargo test (one process for 33 tests) while the fast pass runs nextest (one process per test): harness races between tests of one file only show in the release step
faults_env's <pid>-<call%10> directory could be reused under cargo test; measured margin 5 of 10 later calls (10 instrumented runs), never fired

impact.what: hot_text_products failure message carries the run's exit status and stderr (diagnosability of the release-step reds)
faults_env call directories never shared under cargo test (latent race removed)
train 953 empty-main bound: per-candidate deltas (LD-START-MAPS +2422, SHSTK-OPT-IN-2 +362, THREAD-CREATE-COST +3 instr)

improvement: Run the CI release step's hot_text_products under nextest too (or the fast pass under cargo test once): the two runners differ in process sharing, so the release step is the only place cross-test harness races can show
next_step: Land this branch; on the next release-step red read the stderr in the failure line; LD-START-MAPS to account for its +2422 instructions
